# Social Preview Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that sends real requests to your page and its og:image/twitter:image, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on missing tags, a relative og:image URL, an image too small for Facebook/LinkedIn or Twitter's large-image card, and the twitter:image -> og:image fallback chain.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
